entities.name: RlmN-like query protein
observations: 376-aa sequence; closest curated homologs are reviewed bacterial RlmN proteins, with 46.9–48.3% identity over 94.1–95.7% query coverage (E-values 2.46e-101 to 2.73e-101).
Homology supports dual-specificity methylation of A2503 in 23S rRNA and A37 in tRNA; this remains an inference for the query sequence.
Curated RlmN homologs are annotated EC 2.1.1.192 and bind a [4Fe-4S] cluster plus exchangeable S-adenosyl-L-methionine.

entities.name: RlmN 23S rRNA methylation
observations: Adenosine at position 2503 in 23S rRNA is methylated to 2-methyladenosine; the reported overall equation consumes two SAM and two reduced [2Fe-2S]-ferredoxin equivalents and yields 5'-deoxyadenosine, methionine, SAH, and oxidized ferredoxin (RHEA:42916).

entities.name: RlmN tRNA methylation
observations: Adenosine at position 37 in tRNA is methylated to 2-methyladenosine; reference reaction mapping includes RHEA:43332.

entities.name: [4Fe-4S] cluster
observations: Reviewed RlmN homologs bind a [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines; exchangeable SAM is also reported.
